name: Director and Officer Indemnification Agreement
description: Standalone DGCL § 145 indemnification agreement between a corporation and one director or officer, reviewed for the advancement, determination, and survival terms a director's counsel negotiates. Selects the GOV-139..148 ruleset (10 checks).

distinguishing_phrases: by or in the right of the corporation

compliance_matrix_columns: Fullest extent permitted and the § 145(a) standard of conduct
Mandatory indemnification on success on the merits
Advancement of expenses before final disposition
Undertaking to repay, unsecured and without regard to ability to pay
Derivative-proceeding limit and the court's saving determination
Determination of entitlement and who makes it
Presumption of entitlement and burden of proof
Survival after service ends and against later amendment
